retiredChecks.subject: apps/mobile/src/screens/Search/index.tsx
retiredChecks.history: THE RATCHET NEVER RATCHETED. Born at 034ad4adc (2026-02-16) against a 6,211-line screens/Search/index.tsx holding 71 useEffect/useLayoutEffect and 114 useCallback/useMemo call sites, in a screens/Search/ tree of 115 files. The concentration law WON: that root is now 87 lines with 0 effects and 0 derivations, and screens/Search/ is 689 files (runtime/ alone is 615). But measured against the BIRTH actuals, the S9B and S9C effect budgets (101, 97) were already slack by 30 and 26 the day they were committed, and both derivation budgets (238, 228) were slack by more than 100. Only S11's 70 was ever binding, by one, and it stopped being binding the moment the decomposition started. Five of six were never in their lives capable of failing; the 101 -> 97 -> 70 descent was a ceiling drawn above the ceiling. Retiring them is proven safe by that same measurement: nothing green becomes greener. They are replaced by the two max_per_file_in_tree checks in S11, which re-derive the SUBJECT — a concentration law names a TREE, not a file, and the quantity is a MAXIMUM OVER FILES.
